title: Kissed Mediterranean Eggplant Tagine
description: A sweet, dense vegan tagine infused with Chinese sesame sauce, smoky eggplant, and Mediterranean spices, ideal for a Buddha‑friendly feast.
instructions: Slice 2 medium eggplants into 1/2-inch thick rounds and arrange them on a parchment-lined tray; sprinkle with a pinch of smoked paprika, sea salt, and pepper.
Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a large, deep skillet over medium heat and sear the eggplant slices until golden brown, then set aside.
In the same skillet, add another tablespoon of olive oil and sauté 1 diced onion, 3 minced garlic cloves, and 1 tablespoon grated ginger until fragrant.
Stir in 1 cup of crushed tomatoes, 1 cup of vegetable broth, 1 teaspoon each of ground cumin, ground coriander, and smoked paprika, then bring to a simmer.
Whisk together 1 tablespoon sesame paste, 1 tablespoon soy sauce, 1 tablespoon maple syrup, and the juice of one lemon; pour the mixture into the skillet and stir to coat the vegetables.
Return the seared eggplant slices to the skillet, reduce heat to low, cover, and cook for 20 minutes until the eggplant is tender and the sauce thickens.
Garnish the tagine with toasted sesame seeds and chopped fresh parsley before serving hot over couscous or quinoa.
